subscription.title: Plans
subscription.intro: Every plan works on gifos.app/meet. Public open-floor meetings are always free.
subscription.upgradeNow: Your new plan starts as soon as PayPal confirms it.
subscription.upgradeCancel: We then cancel the plan it replaces, so you are never billed twice. Time left on the old plan is not carried over; the 14-day refund in our Terms still applies to it.
subscription.upgradePass: A four-hour pass is never cancelled: it keeps running beside any plan, and the better of the two is the one in use.
subscription.fileNote: Your plan lives in this browser. Keep a copy: download your subscription file from Settings in a meeting.
subscription.heldNone: This browser holds no plan: you have Free.
subscription.heldSubEnds: This browser holds {plan}. It is cancelled and ends on {until}.
subscription.heldPass: A four-hour pass is on until {until}.
subscription.heldPassNever: A pass with no end is on.
subscription.thanks: Thank you. Your new plan is on.
subscription.notConfirmed: PayPal did not confirm the payment.
subscription.passThanks: Thank you. Your four-hour pass is on.
subscription.broadcast: Get it in the Broadcast app
subscription.agreePre: By paying you agree to the
subscription.charges: Charges show as Crowd Concepts (the company behind GifOS).
subscription.free.name: Free
subscription.free.desc: Hosted meetings of up to 5 people, voice through our relay servers, one meeting at a time.
subscription.pass.name: Four-hour pass
subscription.pass.desc: Unlimited for 4 hours in one meeting at a time, without taking charge of open-floor meetings.
subscription.room20.name: Room 20
subscription.room20.desc: Hosted meetings of up to 20 people, video through our relay servers, one meeting at a time.
subscription.unlimited.name: Unlimited
subscription.unlimited.desc: Hosted meetings with no people limit, video through our relay servers, taking charge of open-floor meetings, one meeting at a time.
subscription.streamer.name: Streamer
subscription.streamer.desc: Everything in Unlimited, plus My library for recordings and transcripts. Sold in the Broadcast app.
subscription.family.name: Family business
subscription.family.desc: Everything in Unlimited, in up to 5 meetings at once.
subscription.smallBusiness.name: Small business
subscription.smallBusiness.desc: Everything in Unlimited, in up to 10 meetings at once.
subscription.business.name: Business
subscription.business.desc: Everything in Unlimited, in up to 100 meetings at once.
subscription.enterprise.name: Enterprise
subscription.enterprise.desc: Everything in Unlimited, in up to 10,000 meetings at once. Paid by invoice.
subscription.negotiated.name: Negotiated
subscription.negotiated.desc: More than 10,000 meetings at once, on terms we agree with you.
